methodologyNotes: Specs sourced primarily from PassMark CPU benchmark detail pages (cpubenchmark.net) and verified against manufacturer/authoritative sources. CORRECTIONS APPLIED during adversarial review (2026-06-15): (1) Ryzen 9 9950X3D priceUsd corrected $899->$699 (AMD launch MSRP per Tom's Hardware/HotHardware), boost_clock_ghz 5.6->5.7, l3_cache_mb 192->128 (192 MB belongs to the later 9950X3D2 Dual Edition, not the standard 9950X3D), and release 2025-Q4->2025-Q1 (launched March 12, 2025). (2) Ryzen 9 9900X3D priceUsd $499->$599 (AMD launch MSRP). (3) Ryzen 9 9950X priceUsd $549->$649 (AMD Aug-2024 launch MSRP, The FPS Review). (4) Ryzen 9 9900X priceUsd $449->$499 (AMD Aug-2024 launch MSRP, The FPS Review). Intel Arrow Lake (Core Ultra 200S) launch MSRPs ($589/$394/$309 for 285K/265K/245K) are Intel RCP from the October 24, 2024 launch (285K verified vs Intel ARK/retail). Ryzen 7 9800X3D ($479), 9700X ($359), Ryzen 5 9600X ($279), Ryzen 7 7800X3D ($449), and Intel Core i5-14600K ($319, Oct 2023) launch MSRPs verified and unchanged. base_clock_ghz reflects the P-core base clock for hybrid Intel CPUs. boost_clock_ghz reflects max single-core turbo for all CPUs. tdp_w reflects base TDP/PBP for Intel CPUs (125W for all three Arrow Lake K-series). All numbers are unit-free; units implied by key name. accessedAt is 2026-06-15 on all sources.
